# e2b_template_alias (Data Source)

Reads the template ID and visibility for an E2B template alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_template_alias" "base" {
  alias = "base"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Template alias.

### Read-Only

- `public` (Boolean) Whether the aliased template is public.
- `template_id` (String) Template ID for the alias.
